page.overview:
What is Nagagutsu Kingdom?

The Nagagutsu Kingdom is a World Government-affiliated nation in the East Blue that is ruled by King Furarri.

It is also the headquarters of the Nyornyo Nyarmani fashion brand.

Nothing is currently known about this island's geography as it has yet to make an appearance.

King Furrari and Prince Tritobu attended the Levely in Mary Geoise.
